  5. 05 Settings sections <section>
    Tabs Card Alert and badge
    Settings sections 
    <section class="card card--flat" aria-labelledby="settings-title">
        <div class="card__body">
          <h2 class="visually-hidden" id="settings-title">Settings sections</h2>
          <div class="tabs" data-tabs>
            <div class="tabs__list" data-tabs-list data-label="Settings" hidden>
              <button type="button" class="tabs__tab" data-tab="settings-profile">Profile</button>
              <button type="button" class="tabs__tab" data-tab="settings-appearance">Appearance</button>
              <button type="button" class="tabs__tab" data-tab="settings-data">Data sources</button>
              <button type="button" class="tabs__tab" data-tab="settings-notifications">Notifications</button>
            </div>

            <section class="tabs__panel" id="settings-profile" aria-labelledby="settings-profile-h">
              <h3 class="tabs__heading" id="settings-profile-h">Profile</h3>
              <form class="form settings-form" action="/account/profile" method="post" data-validate data-demo-submit="Profile saved.">
                <div class="form-row">
                  <div class="field">
                    <label class="field__label" for="profile-name">Full name</label>
                    <input class="input" id="profile-name" name="name" type="text" autocomplete="name" value="Jordan Diaz" required aria-describedby="profile-name-error" data-error-required="Enter your name.">
                    <p class="field__error" id="profile-name-error"></p>
                  </div>
                  <div class="field">
                    <label class="field__label" for="profile-email">Email</label>
                    <input class="input" id="profile-email" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" value="jordan@example.com" required aria-describedby="profile-email-error">
                    <p class="field__error" id="profile-email-error"></p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div class="field">
                  <label class="field__label" for="profile-role">Role</label>
                  <select class="select" id="profile-role" name="role">
                    <option>Owner</option>
                    <option selected>Admin</option>
                    <option>Analyst</option>
                    <option>Support</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div class="field">
                  <label class="field__label" for="profile-bio">Bio</label>
                  <p class="field__hint" id="profile-bio-hint">Shown to teammates. Up to 280 characters.</p>
                  <textarea class="textarea" id="profile-bio" name="bio" maxlength="280" aria-describedby="profile-bio-hint">Runs operations and analytics at Acme.</textarea>
                </div>
                <div class="form-actions">
                  <button type="submit" class="btn">Save profile</button>
                </div>
                <p class="alert alert--success" data-form-status hidden></p>
              </form>
            </section>

            <section class="tabs__panel" id="settings-appearance" aria-labelledby="settings-appearance-h">
              <h3 class="tabs__heading" id="settings-appearance-h">Appearance</h3>
              <div class="stack settings-form">
                <p>Choose light or dark mode, a brand colour (or any custom colour), density and corner style. Changes apply to every template and are remembered on this device.</p>
                <p><button type="button" class="btn btn--secondary" commandfor="theme-panel" command="show-modal" data-theme-panel-trigger hidden><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 21v-7M4 10V3M12 21v-9M12 8V3M20 21v-5M20 12V3M1 14h6M9 8h6M17 16h6"/></svg> Open theme customizer</button></p>
                <p class="text-sm text-muted">Developers: the panel generates CSS for <code>brand.css</code>. See <a href="../../../docs/THEMING.md">docs/THEMING.md</a>.</p>
              </div>
            </section>

            <section class="tabs__panel" id="settings-data" aria-labelledby="settings-data-h">
              <h3 class="tabs__heading" id="settings-data-h">Data sources</h3>
              <form class="form settings-form" data-source-form action="settings.html" method="get">
                <p>Charts, tables and the AI assistant read JSON from <code>src/data/</code>. Point them at your own API by entering a base URL. Each endpoint must return the same shape as the sample files.</p>
                <div class="field">
                  <label class="field__label" for="data-base">Data base URL</label>
                  <p class="field__hint" id="data-base-hint">Relative path or https URL. Requests go to <code>&lt;base&gt;sales.json</code>, <code>&lt;base&gt;orders.json</code> and <code>&lt;base&gt;customers.json</code>. External hosts must be allowed in your Content-Security-Policy <code>connect-src</code>.</p>
                  <input class="input" id="data-base" name="base" type="text" inputmode="url" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" placeholder="../../data/" aria-describedby="data-base-hint data-base-status">
                </div>
                <div class="form-actions">
                  <button type="submit" class="btn"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><ellipse cx="12" cy="5" rx="9" ry="3"/><path d="M21 12c0 1.66-4 3-9 3s-9-1.34-9-3"/><path d="M3 5v14c0 1.66 4 3 9 3s9-1.34 9-3V5"/></svg> Save and test</button>
                  <button type="button" class="btn btn--ghost" data-source-reset>Use sample data</button>
                </div>
                <p class="text-sm" id="data-base-status" role="status" data-source-status></p>
                <div class="table-wrapper" role="region" aria-labelledby="endpoints-caption" tabindex="0">
                  <table class="table">
                    <caption id="endpoints-caption">Expected endpoints</caption>
                    <thead>
                      <tr><th scope="col">Endpoint</th><th scope="col">Shape</th><th scope="col">Used by</th></tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      <tr><td><code>sales.json</code></td><td>Object with monthly, daily, channels, regions, categories, devices and segments arrays</td><td>Overview, analytics, customers charts</td></tr>
                      <tr><td><code>orders.json</code></td><td>Array of orders (id, customer, email, date, status, items, products, total, channel, country)</td><td>Order grids, assistant</td></tr>
                      <tr><td><code>customers.json</code></td><td>Array of customers (id, name, email, segment, orders, spent, country, joined, lastOrder)</td><td>Customer grid, assistant</td></tr>
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </form>
            </section>

            <section class="tabs__panel" id="settings-notifications" aria-labelledby="settings-notifications-h">
              <h3 class="tabs__heading" id="settings-notifications-h">Notifications</h3>
              <form class="form settings-form" action="/account/notifications" method="post" data-validate data-demo-submit="Notification preferences saved.">
                <fieldset class="fieldset">
                  <legend class="fieldset__legend">Email me about</legend>
                  <label class="choice"><input type="checkbox" name="notify" value="orders" checked> New orders over $500</label>
                  <label class="choice"><input type="checkbox" name="notify" value="refunds" checked> Refund requests</label>
                  <label class="choice"><input type="checkbox" name="notify" value="weekly"> Weekly performance summary</label>
                  <label class="choice"><input type="checkbox" name="notify" value="ai"> AI assistant insights</label>
                </fieldset>
                <fieldset class="fieldset">
                  <legend class="fieldset__legend">Digest frequency</legend>
                  <label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="digest" value="daily"> Daily</label>
                  <label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="digest" value="weekly" checked> Weekly</label>
                  <label class="choice"><input type="radio" name="digest" value="never"> Never</label>
                </fieldset>
                <div class="form-actions">
                  <button type="submit" class="btn">Save preferences</button>
                </div>
                <p class="alert alert--success" data-form-status hidden></p>
              </form>
            </section>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
  6. 06 Theme panel Shared partial
    src/layouts/partials/theme-panel.html
    Theme panel 
    <dialog class="dialog drawer" id="theme-panel" aria-labelledby="theme-panel-title" closedby="any">
  <div class="dialog__header">
    <h2 class="dialog__title" id="theme-panel-title">Customize theme</h2>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn--ghost btn--icon" commandfor="theme-panel" command="close">
      <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12"/></svg>
      <span class="visually-hidden">Close theme panel</span>
    </button>
  </div>
  <form class="dialog__body form" data-theme-customizer>
    <fieldset class="fieldset">
      <legend class="fieldset__legend">Mode</legend>
      <div class="segmented">
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="mode" value="system"><span class="segmented__label">System</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="mode" value="light"><span class="segmented__label"><svg class="icon icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><path d="M12 2v2M12 20v2M4.93 4.93l1.41 1.41M17.66 17.66l1.41 1.41M2 12h2M20 12h2M6.34 17.66l-1.41 1.41M19.07 4.93l-1.41 1.41"/></svg> Light</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="mode" value="dark"><span class="segmented__label"><svg class="icon icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1 1 11.21 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.79z"/></svg> Dark</span></label>
      </div>
    </fieldset>

    <fieldset class="fieldset">
      <legend class="fieldset__legend">Brand colour</legend>
      <div class="swatches">
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="indigo"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--indigo"></span> Indigo</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="teal"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--teal"></span> Teal</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="violet"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--violet"></span> Violet</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="rose"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--rose"></span> Rose</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="amber"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--amber"></span> Amber</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="slate"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--slate"></span> Slate</label>
      </div>
    </fieldset>

    <div class="field">
      <label class="field__label" for="theme-custom-color">Or pick any brand colour</label>
      <p class="field__hint" id="theme-custom-hint">Shades are adjusted automatically to keep text readable in both themes.</p>
      <input class="color-input" id="theme-custom-color" name="custom" type="color" value="#2a4fcf" aria-describedby="theme-custom-hint">
    </div>

    <p class="text-sm text-muted" role="status" data-theme-contrast></p>

    <fieldset class="fieldset">
      <legend class="fieldset__legend">Density</legend>
      <div class="segmented">
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="density" value="compact"><span class="segmented__label">Compact</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="density" value="default"><span class="segmented__label">Default</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="density" value="comfortable"><span class="segmented__label">Comfortable</span></label>
      </div>
    </fieldset>

    <fieldset class="fieldset">
      <legend class="fieldset__legend">Corners</legend>
      <div class="segmented">
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="radius" value="sharp"><span class="segmented__label">Sharp</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="radius" value="default"><span class="segmented__label">Default</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="radius" value="round"><span class="segmented__label">Round</span></label>
      </div>
    </fieldset>

    <div class="field">
      <label class="field__label" for="theme-css-output">CSS for your project</label>
      <textarea class="textarea textarea--code" id="theme-css-output" readonly rows="8" data-theme-output></textarea>
    </div>

    <div class="form-actions">
      <button type="button" class="btn btn--sm" data-copy data-copy-target="#theme-css-output" hidden><span data-copy-label>Copy CSS</span></button>
      <button type="button" class="btn btn--sm btn--ghost" data-theme-reset>Reset to defaults</button>
    </div>
  </form>
</dialog>
